title: Concubine Yun
summary: Leaving through the Chaotic Broken Stars, Wang Lin, at late Core Formation, fights stone copies of himself and finds that they can copy his treasures but not the body rebuilt by the Ancient God's power. He comes out beside Mo Yun, last disciple of the Qihuang Sect, who is fleeing Qian Kun of the Poison Demon Palace for stealing her sect's ancestral furnace. Both take him for a Soul Formation expert, and Mo Yun tells him that Hunchback Meng, Duanmu Ji, the Six Desire Devil Lord and the old Ancient Emperor of the Heavenly Devil Cave vanished in the Broken Stars 200 years ago. Because Qian Kun belongs to Meng's line and could spread word of his escape, Wang Lin has Xu Liguo devour him, absorbs most of his golden core, and puts an ancient restriction on Mo Yun that flares every three days. In Qilin City, one of the ten great cities of the Sea of Devils, he unseals relic treasures and buys materials for restriction flags, wondering where Li Muwan is after 200 years, then lets Mo Yun look for anyone who can break his restriction.
